---
title: "Markers"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F, message = F, warning = F)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
Dat <- readRDS("1.initialDat(res0.5,0.6).rds")
DefaultAssay(Dat) <- "RNA"
# ftpt w 4 h 3 
# vlpt w 4 h 3
```

### Overall result

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
DimPlot(Dat, label = T)+NoLegend()
```


### Monocytes

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
FeaturePlot(Dat, features = strsplit("CSF1R, MST1R, CD14, FCGR3A, MS4A7, TNFSF13", ", ")[[1]], label = T, ncol = 3)
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
VlnPlot(Dat, features = strsplit("CSF1R, MST1R, CD14, MS4A7, TNFSF13", ", ")[[1]], ncol = 3)
```
